document_metadata.document_title: South Carolina Stormwater Management BMP Handbook (BMP Field Manual)
document_metadata.version_or_edition: July 31, 2005 (structural BMP sections; handbook sections revised through 2025)

design_criteria.water_quality_volume_method: Wet detention ponds: permanent pool volume equals 1 inch of runoff per impervious acre (0.5 inch for wet extended ponds with aquatic bench; 0.1 inch for micropool extended ponds). Dry detention lower stage detains the water quality volume for at least 24 hours.
peak_flow_calculation_method: Hydrologic analysis for outlet structure sizing (water quality and quantity control)
